title: Full-coordinate OR function
statement: For every nonnegative integer $n$, the function that returns $1$ exactly when all coordinates in the full set $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$ are $1$ agrees with the function that returns $1$ exactly when every coordinate is $1$.
